justification.text: The divisor (t : ℝ)^n - 1 is a real subtraction and is positive, because the hypothesis t > 1 and the index n : ℕ+ (so n ≥ 1) give t^n > 1; the sum is the registry's ∑_{n≥1} 1/(t^n - 1) with every denominator nonzero.
`t > 1` is the docstring's 'Let t > 1 be a rational number': strict, as the problem states (at t = 1 the series has zero denominators).
